description: Pinned JSON-RPC requests vscode-mssql 1.45.0 sends to its bundled SqlToolsService for the Object Explorer tree. Captured over the language-service stdio transport; this file records the request method names and the TDS probes SqlToolsService emits between itself and the SQL Server endpoint. The differential harness (tests/vscode_mssql/tests/object_explorer.rs) asserts Iridium responds to each with the pinned status below.
status_note: Iridium replays the underlying T-SQL probes (SSMS contract); the JSON-RPC framing itself is exercised by this harness. Unsupported branches (e.g. SMO enumerator URN queries against object types Iridium does not model) are marked 'unsupported' individually.

requests.tds_probe: SELECT t.name, t.object_id, SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) AS schema_name FROM sys.tables t
SELECT c.name, c.column_id, c.system_type_id, c.user_type_id, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id = @object_id
SELECT i.name, i.index_id, i.type, i.is_unique FROM sys.indexes i WHERE i.object_id = @object_id
SELECT name, type FROM sys.key_constraints UNION ALL SELECT name, type FROM sys.check_constraints UNION ALL SELECT name, type FROM sys.default_constraints
SELECT p.name, p.parameter_id, t.name AS type_name, p.max_length, p.precision, p.scale FROM sys.parameters p JOIN sys.types t ON p.user_type_id = t.user_type_id WHERE p.object_id = @object_id
SELECT name, type_desc, SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id) AS schema_name FROM sys.objects WHERE name LIKE @pattern + '%' OR name LIKE '%' + @pattern + '%' ORDER BY name

unsupported_jsonrpc_methods.reason: HADR metadata is a documented shim (compatibility-matrix.md).
